description: This Java class defines a response object for retrieving an ACL entry in a system managing 'things'. It serializes, deserializes, and provides accessors for ACL entry data, associated headers, and JSON representations. It includes factory methods for creating instances from various inputs and overrides methods for JSON payload handling, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: RetrieveAclEntryResponse
classes.description: A response class for retrieving an ACL entry associated with a 'thing', capable of serialization/deserialization, and providing access to ACL entry data, HTTP status, headers, and JSON entity representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a Response object given a ThingId, AclEntry, and Headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Response object from a JSON string or JsonObject and headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing associated with this response.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the JSON entity (permissions) and returns a new Response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new Response with updated headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for this ACL entry, based on its subject.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON, including all relevant fields.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions. Currently only V_1.
